discrimination_requirement: Any accepted explanation must distinguish the 5 wrong cases from the 3 correct ones in the same scene. An account that applies equally to both explains neither.
four_distinct_claims: runtime: PhysX exposes a physical shape
targetability: our intervention can isolate that shape
observation: that shape caused the hit

hypotheses.name: PROBE_GEOMETRY
hypotheses.claim: The ray cannot isolate the declared target in dense geometry.
hypotheses.supports: A nearer collider lies on the segment ahead of the target.
hypotheses.falsifies: No collider intersects the segment before the target's own bounds.

hypotheses.name: PHYSICAL_OWNER_MAPPING
hypotheses.claim: PhysX returns a different USD prim for the same physical object.
hypotheses.supports: Returned prim and target share a collision-owning ancestor and one collision shape.
hypotheses.falsifies: They are separate collision shapes with separate rigid-body owners.

hypotheses.name: AUTHORED_RUNTIME_MISMATCH
hypotheses.claim: CollisionAPI is authored but no queryable runtime shape exists.
hypotheses.supports: Target unhittable from every valid local direction while neighbours are hit.
hypotheses.falsifies: Target is hit cleanly from at least one short-range local direction.

hypotheses.name: BOUNDS_MISMATCH
hypotheses.claim: Probe built from render bounds that differ from the collision shape.
hypotheses.supports: Collision hit location lies substantially outside the render bounds used.
hypotheses.falsifies: Hit location falls within the bounds the probe was constructed from.

hypotheses.name: COMPOUND_COLLIDER
hypotheses.claim: Collision is owned by a compound parent, not the authored child.
hypotheses.supports: Authored count enumerates children while PhysX exposes one parent shape.
hypotheses.falsifies: Each authored child has its own distinct runtime shape.

hypotheses.name: QUERY_FILTER
hypotheses.claim: The target is excluded by scene-query filtering.
hypotheses.supports: Target unhittable under this filter and hittable with filtering relaxed.
hypotheses.falsifies: Filter state is identical for the 3 correct and 5 wrong cases.

hypotheses.name: INSTANCE_IDENTITY
hypotheses.claim: Hit is correct but returned under an instance/prototype identity.
hypotheses.supports: Returned path resolves through an instance proxy to the declared target.
hypotheses.falsifies: Returned path resolves to a distinct authored object.
